# C-Suite Coach: code map

**What it is:** Executive training for the C-suite: real business cases, boardroom challenges and spaced-repetition drills. Earn C-Suite Coach Institute certificates.
**Live:** https://csuite-coach.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/csuitecoach · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/csuitecoach/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py csuitecoach` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Converted to native Forms on branch `forms` (2026-11-07)** from the JavaScript-pages version (old folder
  `csuitecoach`, tools/deploy.py). Addresses, server code (only type annotations added for `anvil validate`) and
  db_schema are unchanged, so shared certificate / verify / case links keep working.
- **Engines that stay JavaScript**: `theme/assets/cs-cert.js` (`window.CS`): the certificate (1000x707, fixed paper
  colours in both themes, scaled by ResizeObserver), the seal, progress rings, confetti, dates. Wrapped by
  `client_code/cs.py` and `Components/Certificate`, `Seal`, `Ring`. Its small print and the seal's 7px ring text are
  to scale on purpose (design.js reports the textpath; leave it).
- **The flashcard engine is Python**: `Components/Drill` (reveal, rate, Space / 1 / 2 keys, "Still learning" items
  come back once outside exams). The card stays hidden until `start()`; Study saves each rating at once (rate_item),
  the Exam keeps ratings in the page and the server re-checks every picked item was rated (submit_exam).
- **Exam integrity lives on the server** (Exams.py): honour code, every recall item rated, 30-minute retake, rubric
  ticks clamped to the rubric length, credentials issued only there (codes CSC-<TRACK>-<YEAR>-XXXXXX).
  `Components/Rubric` = native tick boxes (`Items/RubricRow`), locked after the score is recorded.
- **Hero band** = `Components/Hero` (photo, crumbs, title = the page's only h1, lead, meta, action links via
  `Items/LinkButton`). Eyebrow labels were folded into headings / meta (design kit).
- **Display-only text in items** uses `anvil:dom-node` + textContent to keep the old CSS structure; don't put
  `anvil:name` and `anvil:dom-node` on the same element. CSS `url()` in app.css is relative to `_/theme/` (write
  `url(ph-x.jpg)`); inline styles set from Python use `_/theme/ph-x.jpg`.
- **Tests**: tools/ui/flow.js (journeys), exam.js (a fresh member completes Executive Foundations, passes the exam,
  verifies the new code), admin.js (revoke / reinstate shows on the public register), phone.js, a11y.js, design.js.
  Demo credential codes used by tests: CSC-CFO-2026-T4WX9N, CSC-FEL-2026-D9RV3C (DemoData).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **attempts**: user→users, challenge:str, module:str, answer:str, points:obj, score:num, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Learning
- **card_state**: user→users, item:str, module:str, box:num, due:date, reviews:num, lapses:num, last:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Curriculum, DemoData, Exams, Learning
- **credentials**: user→users, track:str, code:str, holder:str, issued:dt, score:num, revoked:bool, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Credentials, Curriculum, DemoData, Exams, Learning
- **exams**: user→users, track:str, started:dt, finished:dt, card_score:num, scenario_score:num, passed:bool, detail:obj, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Exams
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **module_progress**: user→users, module:str, read_at:dt, challenge_score:num, completed_at:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Curriculum, DemoData, Learning
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, xp:num, streak:num, last_study:date, job_title:str, honour_roll:bool · used in Admin, DemoData

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
